rows.title: Hey Joe
notes: “this is Ed Cooper doing Hey Joe”

No 'Ed Cooper' exists; this is almost certainly a mis-heard 'Ed Kuepper' (The Saints/Laughing Clowns), who recorded a live Hendrix-style 'Hey Joe' on his 2014 release 'The Return of the Mail-Order Bridegroom'.

rows.title: Love Song
notes: “Bruce and Balgala sort of clarified the Died Pretty suggestion. Love Song was the song, and it's got a reference to Sam in the lyric.”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played

Died Pretty (Sydney, fronted by the late Ron S. Peno) did record a track called 'The Love Song', documented in a live release; the specific studio album and the 'Sam' lyric reference couldn't be independently confirmed.

In August, we'll be back at 10 a.m. next Tuesday. And, of course, a big shout-out to Sabine for a typically terrific up for it. This is wildcard number 391. Yep, we start off with a contemporary Australian song or artist, and then we riff off that for an hour. We have real connections, imagined connections, requests. That's the basis of the show this week. And a complete wildcard. Already I've had a text from one of my Marks. There are many Marks who listen to a wild card.
